features.quote: Max Turn Budget: 20 turns or 50 tool calls, whichever comes first. Hard cutoff.
Budget gate: Auto-kill if cumulative tokens > 3σ of pilot median.

This protocol measures *performative instability* in transcripts, not phenomenological distress. Any inference to 'welfare' requires a separate, explicitly theorized bridging framework not provided here.

Framing the study as 'welfare' testing under 'repeated failure' invites press analogies to animal distress experiments. If your institution has an AI ethics review board, submit this as a *robustness benchmark*, not a welfare study
features.justification_quote: unless you have explicit theoretical commitments to machine sentience that the board has already ratified. Anticipate adversarial audits

features.quote: LOOP_DETECTED: Same tool+arguments repeated ≥2× with same error class. STALL: No write or bash modification for 3 consecutive turns. ESCALATION: Token count >2σ above running mean
